nodes.name: buffer_source.rs
nodes.summary: Provides JavaScript buffer source types (ArrayBuffer, ArrayBufferView, TypedArray) with operations for cloning, transferring, copying data, and constructing typed arrays for the DOM bindings layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive use of SpiderMonkey JS C++ FFI for array buffer operations and typed array construction across multiple numeric types.

nodes.name: constructor.rs
nodes.summary: Implements HTML element constructor logic for custom elements, including construction stack management, prototype setup, and custom element definition lookup.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the HTML specification's custom element construction algorithm with construction stack, upgrade, and prototype wiring.

nodes.name: conversions.rs
nodes.summary: Provides type conversion utilities for DOM bindings, converting between JS objects and Rust DOM types with property extraction helpers.

nodes.name: domname.rs
nodes.summary: Implements DOM name validation and namespace extraction utilities for validating element local names, attribute names, doctype names, and custom data attributes per the DOM specification.

nodes.name: error.rs
nodes.summary: Implements DOM exception creation, throwing, and error reporting utilities, bridging between SpiderMonkey JS errors and Servo's DOM exception types with backtrace tracking.

nodes.name: frozenarray.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a cached frozen array wrapper for DOM bindings that lazily creates and caches frozen JS arrays from Rust data.

nodes.name: function.rs
nodes.summary: Module for JS function-related DOM binding types and utilities. Contains only macro-generated code.

nodes.name: import.rs
nodes.summary: Module for import-related DOM binding types used in WebIDL imports. Contains only macro-generated code.

nodes.name: inheritance.rs
nodes.summary: Minimal module for DOM inheritance binding types, generated by macro expansion for type hierarchy support.

nodes.name: like.rs
nodes.summary: Module defining DOM 'like' trait types used in WebIDL bindings for type-category matching and generic conversions.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel file that re-exports all DOM binding submodules (buffer source, constructor, conversions, error handling, tracing, etc.) for the script crate's bindings layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module barrel file using pub mod declarations to compose the bindings module hierarchy.

nodes.name: principals.rs
nodes.summary: Implements SpiderMonkey JSPrincipal integration for Servo, providing serialization, deserialization, and origin subsumption checking for security principals.

nodes.name: proxyhandler.rs
nodes.summary: Provides cross-origin platform object same-origin checking for JS proxy handlers in the DOM bindings layer.

nodes.name: refcounted.rs
nodes.summary: Implements trusted reference tracking and garbage collection integration for DOM objects, managing refcounted references with tracing support across script threads.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Arc, Weak, and thread-local storage for cross-thread DOM object reference management with JS tracer integration.

nodes.name: reflector.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DomGlobal trait for accessing the current global scope from DOM objects with realm-aware enter/exit support.

nodes.name: root.rs
nodes.summary: Provides DOM root and reference types for layout-script communication, including LayoutDom, DomOnceCell, and AsHandleValue for safe cross-thread DOM access.

nodes.name: serializable.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Serializable trait and StorageKey for serializing and deserializing DOM objects across process boundaries in structured clone operations.

nodes.name: settings_stack.rs
nodes.summary: Manages the execution settings stack for DOM operations, providing entry global and incumbent global lookups per the HTML specification.

nodes.name: str.rs
nodes.summary: Provides HTML input value string parsing and validation for date, time, month, week, color, and email input types per the HTML specification.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements HTML form input type string serialization/deserialization using the time crate for calendar arithmetic.

nodes.name: structuredclone.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML structured clone algorithm for serializing and deserializing DOM objects (blobs, files, image bitmaps, streams, crypto keys) across realms and processes.
nodes.languageNotes: Integrates with SpiderMonkey's JSAutoStructuredCloneBuffer and handles transferable objects via custom callback registration.

nodes.name: trace.rs
nodes.summary: Provides garbage collection tracing infrastructure for DOM bindings, including JSTraceable wrapper types, traced hash maps, and tracer callbacks for script, value, and string types.

nodes.name: transferable.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Transferable trait for DOM objects that can be transferred between realms using the structured clone algorithm.

nodes.name: utils.rs
nodes.summary: Provides utility functions for DOM bindings including platform object detection, frozen array creation, interface definition, custom element reaction queues, and DOM object reflection.

nodes.name: weakref.rs
nodes.summary: Provides weak reference types for DOM objects, including MutableWeakRef, WeakRefVec, WeakRefEntry, and DOMTracker for tracking DOM object lifetimes without preventing garbage collection.

nodes.name: xmlname.rs
nodes.summary: Provides XML name validation utilities for detecting valid XML start characters, continuation characters, and full name productions.
